name: Zotero Turbo
summaryZh: 通过 MuPDF 原生库加速 PDF 渲染与全文处理，提供标签休眠、检索缓存、引文和数据库调优等功能，原生库支持 Windows x64、Linux x64 及 macOS Intel/Apple Silicon。
description: All-in-one native performance suite for Zotero 7-10: unified MuPDF 1.28.0 PDF renderer, full-text & Ctrl+F acceleration, smart tab hibernation, parallel search, CSL cache, SQLite tuning & auto-WebP note compression.
